task.title: Viewing Red Hat Quay tag history by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To review changes made to an image over time, you can open its Tag History page in the Red Hat Quay v2 UI. You can search by tag name, filter by date range, and see when each tag was modified.

step.cmd: On the Red Hat Quay v2 UI dashboard, click Repositories in the navigation pane.
Click the name of a repository that has image tags.
Click Tag History. On this page, you can perform the following actions:

ul.li: View tag modification dates and the time at which they were changed
